subject: Sealed-network hardware & patch cadence — follow-up and open asks
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@bioworks.com>, Michael O'Rourke <michael.orourke@bioworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Sealed-network hardware & patch cadence — follow-up and open asks

Hi Lena / Michael —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the open items we agreed to follow up on for the Private (air-gapped) deployment qualification:

Summary (from our notes):
- Deployment target: 2-node inference cluster + 1 HA management appliance, all inside BioWorks sealed lab network.
- Constraints: No outbound internet from inference network; on-site jump host for package pulls; quarterly firmware/OS patch windows only.
- Priority: demo on a representative model and a maintenance/rollback playbook for offline upgrades.

Open asks we need from your side: (can you confirm the bullets and upload the inventory?)
1) Final HW inventory export (CSV) with serials + current firmware versions — we referenced a draft on the call.
2) Acceptance of a pre-approved patching cadence: quarterly security patches + emergency CVE process. Is quarterly acceptable or do you require monthly emergency-only testing windows?
3) Vault/KMS approach: will you provide an HSM for key material, or do we integrate with your KMS over the jump host?
4) Network photos / rack elevations and a simple L2/L3 diagram for the sealed segment — needed for power / cooling checks.

Attachments: site-network-diagram.pdf (we annotated the zone we discussed); current-hw-inventory.csv (redacted sample).

Next proposed steps:
- Lena: share the full inventory and confirm KMS approach by Thu 5/17.
- Redwood: we'll produce a short maintenance playbook (2–3 pages) and an offline upgrade checklist by Mon 5/21.
- Schedule a 45-min on-site ops review (we recommend Ben + one engineer) the week of 5/28.

If any of the asks above are incorrect, tell me and I'll update the plan.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +44 20 7123 4567
From: Dr. Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@bioworks.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael O'Rourke <michael.orourke@bioworks.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 13:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Sealed-network hardware & patch cadence — follow-up and open asks

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Inventory: attaching the "current-hw-inventory.csv" export (redacted) — includes firmware/BIOS versions. Let us know if you need additional fields.
- Patching cadence: quarterly is our standard for sealed lab boxes. For critical CVEs we can open an emergency window but we require a predefined rollback MOP and an on-site engineer present.
- Keys: we will provide an HSM appliance in the management VLAN; we cannot expose KMS over the jump host. You'll need to run the Redwood control plane inside our management VLAN and communicate with the HSM over the internal network.
- Rack photos and L2/L3 diagram attached as site-network-diagram.pdf — the sealed VLAN is fully isolated; only the jump host has egress under strict change control.

We agree to the proposed next steps. Tentative availability for the on-site ops review: week of 5/28 — prefer Thu 5/31.

Notes / constraints: please include the on-site engineer requirement in your maintenance playbook (name/title TBD). Also, we will require a signed Ops Fall-back SLA for any forced emergency patching that mandates rollback windows.

Best,
Lena
Dr. Lena Vogt
Head of IT Ops, BioWorks Therapeutics
lena.vogt@bioworks.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@bioworks.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael O'Rourke <michael.orourke@bioworks.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:37:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Sealed-network hardware & patch cadence — follow-up and open asks

Lena — appreciate the fast turn. Couple of follow-ups from our internal checklist so we don't hit scoping surprises during the on-site: 

1) HSM integration: thanks for confirming an appliance. Could you share the vendor and model (or the management interface docs) so our security engineer can validate compatibility with our key-wrapping flow?
2) Emergency CVE process: understood on your side — we'll draft an "Emergency patch & rollback MOP" and include the requirement for an on-site BioWorks engineer to be present.
3) Capacity & model demo: for the 2-node cluster we recommended, what's your expected peak RPS and typical sequences? We'll size the demo VM accordingly.

Action items (Ben/Redwood)
- I'll upload a 2-page maintenance playbook draft to the HubSpot deal and post the link here by EOD Wed 5/15.
- Sean will produce the offline upgrade checklist.

Could we confirm a 45-min slot on Thu 5/31 at 10:00 CET for the ops review? If that works I can send a calendar invite and an agenda (install validation, HSM handshake, emergency MOP walk-through).

Thanks — Ben
